newsitem.title: USA: Alliance Gaming extends offer's date.
newsitem.headline: Alliance Gaming extends offer's date.

text.p: Gaming company Alliance Gaming Corp said Tuesday it had extended the expiration date until August 7 for its offer to buy all its 12-7/8-percent senior secured notes due 2003.
Alliance said in a statement the new price determination date for the offer will be August 4.
It said it prolonged the offer so that the expiration date coincides with the expected closing of the company's bank and subsordinated note financings.
Of the $154 million of notes outstanding, about $15.9 million or more than 99.9 percent had been tendered by July 28, it added.
